pages.text: Any iron, diamond or netherite weapon or armor can be forged, and a forged piece is always stronger than a plain one. It keeps its usual look; its ★ shows on its name. A plain piece (crafted the usual way, or found) has no ★.
pages.title: Forged Gear

pages.text: The ★ climbs with the material:$(li)$(bold)Iron$(): ★1 to ★3. The usual shape, in forged plates; the worst plate sets the ★.$(li)$(bold)Diamond$(): ★4 or ★5. A forged iron piece and a diamond at a smithing table; ★5 from a ★3 piece.$(li)$(bold)Netherite$(): ★6 or ★7. A forged diamond piece, the usual way; ★7 from ★5.
pages.title: The Stars

pages.text: Each ★ into its material adds 5% to the piece's damage or armor (and the like), and 10% to its durability. A ★3 iron sword is 15% better than a plain one; a ★4 diamond sword 5% better than a plain diamond one, and so on.
pages.title: How Much Better
